detail.longDescription: 🏋️‍♂️ Reversing cardiac aging in middle age! A 2-yr RCT (Howden et al., 2018) shows that 4–5 days/wk of exercise in middle age (45–64 yrs) reverses sedentary LV stiffness, increasing VO_2max by 18% and heart volume (LVEDV) by 17%. ⚡️ The Protocol (4-5 days/week): 1x HIIT (4x4 min at 90-95% HRmax), 1x long session (>60 min), 1-2x moderate sessions, 2x strength workouts, and 1x active recovery day. Early intervention prevents heart failure (HFpEF). https:// doi.org/10.1161/CIRCULATIONAHA .117.030617 # research # publichealth
